name: Macrophage–osteoclast lineage regulation via CSF1 signaling
rationale: All members concern proliferation, fusion and differentiation of macrophages and osteoclasts and bone resorption, and the CSF1/M-CSF receptor (interleukin-family) signaling arm separates it from the DAP12 and monocyte/dendritic-cell differentiation confusables.

name: Platelet activation via soluble-agonist GPCRs
rationale: Members cover platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation and coagulation, and the ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thrombin PAR, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor pathways distinguish it from the collagen/GPIb adhesion and integrin-Rap1 confusables.

name: Planar cell polarity in convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and signaling plus convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate morphogenesis, which the axial-mesoderm and non-canonical Wnt receptor confusables lack.

name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members describe Gi/Gz-coupled receptor inhibition of adenylate cyclase, specifically via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, distinguishing it from muscarinic/adenosine/serotonin Gi confusables, the cAMP-PKA confusable and the catecholamine-secretion confusables.

name: NK cell receptor control of lymphocyte cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are NK cell signatures and receptor activation, MHC class Ib presentation and positive/negative regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity, lacking the granzyme, KIR-tolerance and T cell proliferation content of confusables.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb mesenchymal morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of palate, face, nose, skull and limbs/digits plus mesenchymal cell development, whereas confusables carry pharyngeal endocrine/lymphoid organs or ossification and cartilage.

name: Integrin–fibronectin adhesion in migrating fibroblasts
rationale: Members share integrin production, focal adhesion assembly, fibronectin matrix formation, collagen/TGFB and SRF-driven cytoskeletal remodeling in fibroblast migration, unlike the syndecan/stress-fiber and EMT/YAP confusables.

core: Negative regulation of skeletal muscle growth
name: Negative regulation of skeletal muscle growth and myogenesis
rationale: Members restrain myoblast proliferation/differentiation and muscle development or drive disuse atrophy and satellite-cell quiescence, whereas confusables carry pro-myogenic, hypertrophy or contractile programs.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members are telomere replication, capping, D-loop and t-circle handling, recombination and break-induced replication with intra-S checkpoint and intermediate resolution, distinguishing it from telomerase/C-strand and general DNA repair confusables.

name: cAMP generation and protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members span GPCR-coupled cAMP synthesis, forskolin response and PKA activation, lacking the CREB, dopamine-receptor and phosphodiesterase content of confusables and the cyclase-inhibitory content of C3.

core: Vesicle traffic between Golgi and ER
name: COPI-coated vesicle trafficking between Golgi and ER
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and ER–Golgi vesicle targeting, distinguishing it from COPII export, tethering and ER protein-insertion confusables.

name: Kidney development through nephron tubule patterning
rationale: All members concern nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron development, and the nephron tubule segment differentiation and proximal/distal patterning separate it from ureteric bud induction confusables.

name: Endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members are endosome organization, receptor/endocytic recycling and endosome- or Golgi-to-plasma membrane cargo delivery, unlike confusables centred on retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic, membrane tubulation or constitutive secretion.

name: Myeloid progenitor transcription restraining terminal differentiation
rationale: Members describe transcriptional programs of myeloid progenitors (RUNX1, VENTX, promyelocyte) and negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation, whereas confusables carry positive differentiation and neutrophil/G-CSF content.

name: RAF–MEK–ERK signaling and its feedback inactivation
rationale: Members are RAF, MAP2K and MAPK activation including oncogenic mutants plus ERK negative feedback and dephosphorylation, distinguishing it from RAS GAP and SOS/RIT upstream confusables.

name: Vitamin K and C metabolism with protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members concern vitamin K catabolism and gamma-carboxylation of proteins plus ascorbate metabolism and vitamin responses, distinguishing it from ubiquinone/vitamin E, vitamin D and oxygen-transport confusables.

name: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production
rationale: Members regulate dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5/STAT6 chemokine output with positive cGAS–STING input, unlike the TLR7/8/9, CXCL/macrophage-chemotaxis, Th1/IL-12 and STING-restraint confusables.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and small RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are methylation of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and caps with snoRNP/snRNP assembly and Cajal body localization, distinguishing it from pseudouridylation and diphthamide confusables.

name: Stress-granule control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members are RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability and translation with stress granule assembly/disassembly and PKR/arsenite stress, whereas confusables emphasise TTP/BRF1/KSRP decay, decapping and deadenylation.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation during skeletal cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members are chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy, condensation and joint morphogenesis, lacking the ossification, tendon and articular cartilage homeostasis content of confusables.

name: Islet insulin secretion via nutrient and incretin sensing
rationale: Members concern beta-cell insulin processing and secretion regulated by glucose, fatty acids, KATP channels and GLP-1/GIP, unlike confusables on insulin action, GLUT4 translocation and adiponectin.

name: Ubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination in proteasomal turnover
rationale: Members are ubiquitin chain types, E1/E2/E3 activity, DUB families and proteasome assembly, distinguishing it from autophagy/ERAD quality-control and neddylation/COP9 confusables.

name: GTPase-regulated Golgi organization and COPI retrograde traffic
rationale: Members are Golgi ribbon assembly/disassembly, COPI and intra-Golgi traffic, vesicle tethering and Rab/ARF regulation, lacking the TGN-to-endosome/lysosome, COPII and Ral content of confusables.

name: Glutamine-family amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Members are general amino acid metabolism terms plus proline biosynthesis and catabolism, distinguishing it from glycine/serine/glyoxylate and organic-acid confusables.

name: Retinol metabolism toward retinoic acid synthesis
rationale: Members are retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport, distinguishing it from the visual retinoid cycle, retinoic acid response and vitamin D confusables.

name: Telomere end protection from recombination and end joining
rationale: Members are telomere capping, packaging, inhibition of recombination and NHEJ at telomeres and telomerase restraint, unlike confusables on telomere replication, D-loop/t-circle handling and telomerase extension.

name: Nucleotide and NAD energy-carrier homeostasis via phosphotransfer
rationale: Members are nucleotide phosphorylation/interconversion, mitochondrial ATP/ADP and NAD transport, creatine phosphotransfer and NAD salvage, unlike PRPP, apoptosis and nucleotide-biosynthesis-regulation confusables.

name: Telomere maintenance via telomerase and recombination
rationale: Members span telomerase recruitment and extension, C-strand synthesis, capping and recombination-based telomere maintenance, distinguishing it from general DNA repair, senescence and chromatin confusables.

core: Inflammatory cytokine regulation by TLRs and inflammasomes
name: Bacterial lipid–sensing TLR and inflammasome cytokine regulation
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/4 responses to LPS, lipoteichoic acid and lipopeptides, NLRP1/3 inflammasomes and IL-1/IL-6/TNF production, unlike pyroptosis/CASP4-5, TRIF/CD40 and monocyte-signature confusables.

name: Beta-catenin signaling controlled by AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: Members are canonical Wnt/beta-catenin output and AXIN/APC destruction-complex stability, lacking the DVL/FZD receptor-level and target-repression content of confusables.
